headline: Students' Fake Fight Surprise Ends with Principal Lifted into the Air
meta_description: Georgia students orchestrated an elaborate prank to celebrate Principal Bobby Davis's birthday, staging a fake fight to get him on the scene.
summary_short: Georgia students staged a fake fight to lure Principal Bobby Davis into breaking it up, then surprised him with 'Happy Birthday' and lifted him into the air.
body: Georgia students staged an elaborate prank on Principal Bobby Davis's birthday, faking a fight to draw him into the hallway before surprising him with a group celebration. The students lifted Davis into the air as they erupted into "Happy Birthday," turning what he thought was a crisis into a moment of genuine joy. The prank, orchestrated by students who wanted to mark their principal's special day, reveals the kind of warmth that can exist between students and school leadership. Rather than the usual demands on a principal's attention, Davis found himself at the center of coordinated affection—a reminder that sometimes the best moments come from the people around us choosing to celebrate together.
quick_facts: Georgia students staged a fake fight as a prank
Principal Bobby Davis was lured to break up the 'fight'
Students surprised him with 'Happy Birthday' and lifted him up
The prank was orchestrated to celebrate Davis's birthday
